test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"consequences."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"consequences"** means something that happens or follows as a result of something else, the results or effects of a particular action or situation. (परिणाम, नतीजा, फल, प्रभाव)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because the other options do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** *The **consequences**__ of not studying for exams are usually poor grades.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage: 

The __challenge__ of climate change is one of the most pressing issues facing the world today. Rising temperatures, extreme weather events and melting ice caps are just a few of the __consequences__ of a changing climate. To combat this, many countries have pledged to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions, but progress has been slow. In addition, some people are still sceptical of the ______ (3) _______ of climate change or believe that it's a natural occurrence that humans can't do much about. However, scientists agree that urgent action is needed to prevent the worst impacts of climate change. This includes not only reducing emissions but also adapting to the changes that have already ______ (4) _______. This might involve building sea walls to protect against rising sea levels, planting drought-resistant crops or developing new technologies to remove carbon from the atmosphere. Ultimately, addressing climate change will require a ______ (5) _______ effort from individuals, governments and businesses around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Benefits"** means the advantages or positive outcomes of a particular action or situation. (लाभ, हित, फ़ायदा)
 
• **"Advancements"** means the progress or improvements made in a particular field or area. (उन्‍नति, प्रगति)
 
• **"Improvements"** means the act of making something better or enhancing its quality. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की गुणवत्ता या दशा में बेहतरी के लिए परिवर्तन; सुधार)

13b:T11a9,

The correct answer is **"reality."**
